runtimeSupport.scope: 实现 V1.2 的 XL9535 I²C GPIO、9 位串行屏幕初始化、480×480 ST7701S RGB565 的真实 LCD_CAM／DMA 帧、背光 PWM、BOOT0 与 SPI SD；CST3240 触摸、ESP32-H2、CAN/RS485 未实现。
unsupported: Factory firmware boot and full application behavior remain unverified; no physical hardware validation.

ST7701S has no GRAM; the preview retains the last complete DMA scan. Vendor analog/power/gamma programming and optical timing are not modeled; pixel bus must use native 480x480 RGB565. No host writes manufacture a frame.

Unknown XL9535 external input levels use diagnostic high. LCD reset remains unavailable until firmware explicitly configures P05 output high. This is an explicit simulation startup policy, not a claim about unknown board power-on pull states.
Only supported standard serial commands and physical RGB routes are interpreted. CST3240 address5A remains unattached; H2 CPU/BLE/Thread, CAN/RS485 transceivers and touch gestures are absent.
The storefront also lists Lite and later hardware. This exact V1.2 mapping does not alias T-Panel-Lite, a structurally different board, or claim every later BOM is verified.
runtimeSupport.firmwareCompatibility: No factory image is claimed working by a board protocol test.
